title: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon — Travel page (2026)
claims: Cape Town International Airport is identified as the primary airport serving Cape Town, with a link to the airport's official website.
International visitors may require a visa, and the page directs them to the South African Department of Home Affairs.
The page lists MyCiTi buses, Metrorail trains, taxis and ride-hailing apps such as Uber and Bolt, and car rental including Europcar as ways to get around Cape Town.
The page provides no airport-to-city travel time, transfer frequency or fixed airport shuttle schedule.
